chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the source of the hadith.
key_terms.حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ: A narrator in the sanad/isnad transmitting this report.
key_terms.عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْحَلَبِي: A narrator in the sanad/isnad transmitting from the Imam.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: A narrator in the sanad/isnad transmitting this report.
key_terms.مِثْلُهُ: Meaning: the same as the previous hadith in wording or ruling.

ai.seo_question: What does “مِثْلُهُ” mean in a hadith chain in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This report gives a sanad/isnad to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام and then states only: “The like of it,” indicating that its matn is the same as the preceding narration. In context, it serves as a corroborating hadith within the chapter on tayammum and its rulings.
